page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9a.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9T25 processor running at 2.7 GHz. This instance is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include any local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

The instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this memory-optimized configuration is designed for workloads requiring higher memory density relative to compute resources, such as small-scale databases, caching layers, and memory-intensive enterprise applications that do not require local disk storage or GPU acceleration.
